Shares also benefited from broad strength in tech stocks. items.summary: Bloom Energy just posted record revenue and raised its guidance, yet retail investors are bailing while a short-seller report and class-action inquiry pile on. Find out why analysts and Reddit are reaching completely opposite conclusions about where this stock goes next.
